description: A clinical geneticist whose network status is a tier and not a yes or a no. The status is said to be unrecognised and is treated as neither in network nor out of network. The record arrives as a list of one, the name follows the FHIR shape, and acceptingNewPatients is a field the mapping does not know.
basis: Synthetic. Every value in this file is invented and no real provider was used to make it. The NPI was made with the application's own check digit rule.
